result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations of integrals p and q over s with denominator Δ (involving 1+2xs+s², c³+s) and their partial derivatives with respect to x and log c, combined into a differential expression, apparently for the equilibrium condition of a rotating fluid ellipsoid.
result.transcription:
$p = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(\frac{s+1}{1+2xs+s^2} - \frac{c^3}{c^3+s}\right)$
$= \int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, \frac{(1-2x)s-s^2}{1+2xs+s^2} + \frac{s}{c^3+s}$
$-2\int (1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12} s^{\frac12}\, d(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12} = +2\int (1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12} d\,(1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12} s$
$p = \int \frac{ds}{\Delta}\, \frac{2(1+2xs+s^2) - 2(x+s)s + (1-2x)s - s^2}{1+2xs+s^2}$
$p = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, \frac{2+s-s^2}{1+2xs+s^2}$
$= \int_0^\infty$ [-...-] $(s+\frac1s+2x)^{-\frac32}\, \partial \log s\, (s^{-\frac12}+s^{\frac12})\, \frac{2-s}{\sqrt{1+\frac{s}{c^3}}}$
$\frac{1}{c^3} p = \int_0^1 (s+\frac1s+2x)^{-\frac32}\, \partial\log s\,(s^{-\frac12}+s^{\frac12})\left(2+\frac{1}{c^3} - \sqrt{(1+\frac{s}{c^3})(1+\frac{1}{c^3 s})}\right)\left([-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\frac{s}{c^3}}}-] + \frac{1}{\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{c^3 s}}}\right)$
$4+\frac{4}{c^3}+\frac{1}{c^6} - (1+\frac{1}{c^6}) - (s+\frac1s)\frac{1}{c^3}$
$3+\frac{4}{c^3} - (s+\frac1s)\frac{1}{c^3}$
$2\mu^4(1+2xc^3) + \mu(2(x+x)p+(1-x)q) - \left((x+x)\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log c} + (1-x)\frac{\partial q}{\partial \log c}\right) + 2q(1+2c^3)(x+1) + 2p(1-2c^3)(1-x) + \left((1+2c^3)\frac{\partial q}{\partial x} - (1-2c^3)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}\right) xx-1$
$p = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, \frac{2+s-s^2}{(1+2xs+s^2)}\quad q = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, \frac{-2+s+s^2}{1+2xs+s^2}$
$(1+x)p+(1-x)q = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, 2s+2x(2-s^2)$
$(1+2c^3)q + (2c^3-1)p = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, \frac{4c^3 s - 2(2-s^2)}{1}$
$2(p+q)(1+2c^3x) - 2(p-q)\, x+2c^3 = \int_0^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\, 4s(1+2c^3x) - 4(2-s^2)(x+2c^3)$
$(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = (x+1)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x\partial\log c} - (2x+\frac{1}{2c^3})\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac13 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial\log c}(\frac{1}{c^3}-x) - \frac13\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c}$
$u = \int (1+2xs+s^2)^{-\frac12}(1+\frac{s}{c^3})^{-\frac12}\partial s$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\log c} = \frac32\int \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\frac{s}{s+c^3} = \frac32\int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\left(\frac{s}{c^3}(1+2xs+s^2)\right)$ \quad $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\left(-s(1+\frac{s}{c^3})\right)$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x\partial\log c} = -\frac32\int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\frac{s^2}{c^3}$
$(x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} = \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\left(\frac{s^2}{c^3}\left(-\frac32(x+1) - \frac12(\frac{1}{c^3}-x)\right) + 2x + \frac{1}{2c^3}\right) + (2x+\frac{1}{2c^3})s + \frac12\frac{s}{c^3}(1+2xs+s^2)$
$\frac{s}{c^3}\left( (x-\frac32)\frac{s}{c^3} + 2xc^3 + \frac12 - \frac12(1+2xs+s^2)\right.$
$= \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3} - \frac12\frac{s}{c^3}\left(s^2 + s(2x - \frac{2x}{c^3} + \frac{3}{c^3}) - 4xc^3\right)$
$p = \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\, s\left((1+\frac{1}{c^3}-2x) + s(\frac{1}{c^3}-1)\right)$
$\frac{\partial p}{\partial\log c} = \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\,\frac32\frac{s}{c^3}(2+s-s^2)$
$2p(1-2c^3) - \frac{\partial p}{\partial\log c}(x+1) - \frac{\partial p}{\partial x}(x+1)(x+2c^3)$
$(1-2c^3)(1-x)\quad (x+1)\frac{\partial p}{\partial x} + 2p\quad s^2(c^3+2x)$
$2c^3\left( [-4-] 2(1+xx) - 2\frac{x}{c^3} + 2c^3 4x - 4\right)$
$= \int\frac{\partial s}{\Delta^3}\frac{s}{c^3}\left( [-2xc^3+2c^3...-] 2c^3(1-x+\frac{1}{c^3}) + s(\frac{1}{c^3}-1)(2c^3-x) - \frac{3}{2c^3}\right)$
$-\frac12 s^2$
$(1+2c^3)(1+x)$
$2c^3(1+x-\frac{1}{c^3}) + s(\frac{1}{c^3}+1)(2c^3+x) + \frac{3}{2c^3}$
$+\frac12 s^2$
$\frac32(\frac{1}{c^3}+1)(1+x)$
$(1+s)(1+\frac{s}{c^3}) - 1 + 2xs + s^2$ \quad $(\frac{1}{c^3}+1)\; 1+x \quad -(x-1)$
$(2c^3+1)(2c^3+1)\,2(\frac{1}{c^3}+x) - (x+1)(x+1)(2c^3+\frac{1}{c^3})$
$+\frac32(2x+\frac{1}{c^3})$
$-\frac{s}{2c^3}\left( ((x+2c^3) + 3(x+1))s^2 + s\left((2x - \frac{2x}{c^3} + \frac{3}{c^3})(x+2c^3) - 3(x+1) + 2(\frac{1}{c^3}-1)(1-2c^3)\right) - 4xc^3(x+2c^3) - 6(x+1) + 2(1-2c^3)(1+\frac{1}{c^3}-2x)\right.$
$\frac{1}{c^3}(2+x(3-2x)) + 4c^3(x-1) + 4x^2 - 4x + 6 - 3x - 3 - 1 - 4$
$+4x^2 - 7x - 2$
$\frac{1}{c^3}\,2$
$2(\frac{1}{c^3}-1)(1-2c^3 - xx - 2xc^3) + 3x(\frac{1}{c^3}-1) - 1$

methods.what: Definition of integral p over s with weight 1/Δ
Integration by parts to simplify p
Linear combinations of p and q as single integrals
Generating integral u and its derivatives in x and log c
Derivative of p with respect to log c
Differential combination of p, q and their derivatives (equilibrium-type expression)
